summary: The ETraining document is part of a web application that handles user authentication and redirection to a training platform. It includes server-side code-behind logic and HTML form elements for capturing user credentials and handling secure submissions.
purpose: ETraining is designed to authenticate users and redirect them to a designated training URL, possibly a Moodle training platform, based on user sessions and locale settings.

fields.name: form1
fields.description: HTML form element used for submission

fields.name: Submit
fields.description: Input element for submission with specific styling

actors.name: UserSession
actors.description: Represents the user's session including session ID, locale, province code, and user ID.

workflows.name: User Authentication and Redirection
steps: Check if UserSession.SessionID is greater than 0
Set the form action to a Moodle Training URL
Append a language parameter for French if UserSession.Locale is 'fr-CA'
Set the username and password hidden fields
Set the value of the Submit element
Redirect to Timedout.aspx if the session ID is not valid

conditions.result: Append French language parameter to URL

system_behavior: Generates a web interface for user login and redirection
